correctness.rationale: For polyhedral Euclidean projector onto the inverse image of a path l1 ball, local derivatives are face-tangent orthogonal projectors H=A-gg^T/||g||²; zero-difference edges create consecutive constant blocks and block averaging A contracts path variation. At active jump edges, g=AD^T s satisfies V(g)=sum s_j(Dg)_j=||g||² from the sign alignment. Hence V(Hh)<=V(Ah)+|s^T DA h|<=2V(h), all n and R>0. Complete n=2,3 face derivative classification yields coefficient 1. For n≥4 a strictly monotone arithmetic ramp and middle unit-step perturbation project to the containing endpoint-gap halfspace and attain factor two; scaling handles any R. Independently rederived rational face matrices and checked n=2..5 gains 1,1,2,2; source checker enumerates more cases but is not infinite proof.
residual_risks: Polyhedral tangent interpretation and strictly monotone witness require positive R and unweighted Euclidean path geometry; weighted graphs or R=0 are outside scope.
